planets.name: EPIC 228836835 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of EPIC 228836835 with a 0.728-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: EPIC 228836835 b was found in 2021 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around EPIC 228836835. Its orbit and size follow Adams et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
